author: bardic-inspiration
name: Sky-Chalk
summary: A piece of chalk that draws a bridge through the air.
description: Taught to a generation of mountain climbers, who never mention it to their landlords.

stats.effect: As a Magic action, you can use this chalk to draw a line up to 30 feet long between two points in the air. For 1 hour, the line acts as a solid bridge 3 feet wide that can support up to 500 pounds. The chalk is consumed.
